Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
Kieran wrote:

> 1. Can I stack action modifier and reaction cards, ie play three
> spectral divination to gain +3 intercept? My play group thought
> these and combat cards were covered by NRA, but having read up a
> bit it seems not.

No. They aren't covered by NRA, as they aren't actions, but they are covered
by the rules on action modifiers and reaction cards--you may only play one
of each particular action modifier or reaction per action--.i.e. only one
Lost In Crowds per action; only 1 Enhanced Senses per re-action.

Combat cards, however, are not so restricted, but are restricted by other
rules--you can't use a manuver to cancel your own manuver, you can't press
to cancel your own press, you can't prevent damage that isn't there, and you
can only use 1 card per round to generate an additional strike. You can,
however, stack multiple (non strike) combat cards as appropriate--you can
play, say, 5 Increased Strength for +10 damage on any potence strike you
make, and then Throw a Gate for 12 damage; you can use 3 different
Unflinching Persistience to prevent 3 damage; you can play 4 Torn Signpost
in a single round of combat (although it still won't do anything other than
give you 3 hand damage).

Messages.Body:
"Kieran" <vt...@twisted.org.uk> wrote in message
news:vpfahv07hcio3ebco...@4ax.com...

> 1. Can I stack action modifier and reaction cards, ie play three
> spectral divination to gain +3 intercept? My play group thought
> these and combat cards were covered by NRA, but having read up a
> bit it seems not.
>

Action modifiers and reaction cards are playable at the rate of one card,
per minion, per action. Combat cards have no such limitations (but there
are other rules, like you cannot cancel your own presses or maneuvers, which
limit their play)

. NRA refers to actions only. Its a rule that says within a turn you may
only bleed once, play a political action once, and act with an action card
once, by name on the card (ie no multiple Bum's Rush.

> 2. What types of deck suit do people think suit each clan best? I'm
> making decks for Brujah, !Brujah, Ventrue, Tremere, Giovanni,
> Ravnos and !Gangrel and am more interested in having a range of
> fun decks appropriate to the clans than choosing a few different
> types of decks and then looking at who best to build them with.

Classic uses for these clans
Bru and !Bru: Rush combat. Multiple rush actions to attack the prey's
vampires, lots of Potence and Cel, light Pre bleed to finish them off

Ventrue make good voters, but are often suceptible to block. Keep Majesty
and other untaps handy.

Tremere, well... Ask Xian.

Giovanni: Necro-stealth bleed with Seduction. Library manipulation
(Carlotta), and Summon Soul for boosted hunting

Ravnos: Its all about Gabrin. Keep the high cost Sense Deps to a minimum,
and focus on their efficiency in combat (Trap-Carrion Crows- Apparition) and
their efficiency as blockers (with Draba). Many Ravnos have dominate as a
fourht discipline

!Gangrel: good luck. We're all still working on making _them_ go well.

check out www.thelasombra.com Decks, if you haven't already.

Good luck!

>I knew bleed was non-repeatable.
>I knew you couldn't play the same card with the same minion twice per
>turn, even if you use different effects (such as Govern)
>
>Can a minion undertake only one political action per turn? Or can all of
>your minions only perform one of the same political action a turn? Or is
>it wrong to call a. say KRC, freak drive and play a different political?

each individual minion can only perform a political action once per
turn. if they untap, they may not take any other political actions. it
doesn't matter what they were called or whether they were froma card
in play, card in hand, or other.

but, regardless of what political action that minion took, your other
minions are free to take the same action (by card in play or another
card of the same name in hand or whatever), barring things like
Delaying Tactics or 'once per game' political actions.

>How about Hunt and Diablerie, just to name two actions that can be done
>without a card required. Can you undertake those multiple times? The
>rulebook doesn't mention those, so I suppose you can.
>Say, Muaziz attempts diablerie, gets blocked, sends in a gargoyle slave
>(un untaps as such), and tries to diablerize again. Is that legal?
>Blanche Hill hunts and untaps because it's succesfull and hunts again.
>Legal too?

if your hunt isn't a special action (eg: Kyoko) you can hunt as many
times as you can untap.
diablerie of the same vampire you can take as many times as you want.

they are not carded actions (NRA by name), bleeds or political (NRA),
or actions provided by cards in play (NRA by each card in play)....

(.....despite my assertion to lsj that the diablerie is provided by a
card in play, being the torpored minion...but that's not the way it
works :)

> limit their play)

This isn't quite clear. It's one copy of each reaction/action modifier card
per minion per action.
However almost all modifiers are only usable by the acting vampire -Cloak
the Gathering being the obvious exception.

You can play multiple C the Gathering if you have multiple untapped ready
vampires with superior Obfuscate. Similarly you can play as many telepathic
counters as you have untapped (or waked) vampires with auspex (but no more
than one each). You can also play multiple different modifiers/reactions
with one vampire -eg Wake + Precognition + Enhanced Senses.

It's a fairly obviou clarification but you did say "newbie" so I thought I'd
better make sure ;-)

not sure where you got 'untapped' from.

most standard action modifiers are played by tapped minions. you tap
to announce your action. cloak the gathering has nothing requiring an
untapped minion to play written on it, merely a ready one.

you can play cloak the gathering with a tapped minion. at inferior,
the tapped minion is the acting one. at superior, it's another ready
minion you control.

you can play it if you're untapped as well, though. :)
